name: Schwäbisch Gmünd (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Schwäbisch Gmünd (a white unicorn on red).
history: Municipal flag of Schwäbisch Gmünd; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schwäbisch Gmünd arms — white unicorn on red
